candidates.description: This feature vector activates on tokens containing or related to the Latin root "-atur-" and its morphological variants across multiple languages.
This vector represents demonstrative determiners and related morphological variations in French.
These tokens represent roots and combining forms frequently used in scientific, chemical, and physical terminology.
This feature vector represents terms and root words related to observation, monitoring, and visual or mental perception.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Latin root 'cum' (meaning with or together) and words or fragments containing the letter sequence 'um'.
This vector represents common French adverbs and quantifying terms used to modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs.
This vector represents common French temporal, logical, and modal adverbial modifiers.
This vector represents words or word fragments ending with the letters "ent".
These tokens represent common prefixes and sub-word roots found in Latin-derived and Romance language vocabulary.
This vector represents indefinite and definite articles and determiners primarily in French.
